items.title: Human: Proofreading Te
items.description:
• Slow, tedious; needs fresh eyes and focus.
• Misses own typos, gets tired, subjective style.
• Understands nuance, intent, and subtle tone.

items.title: AI: Proofreading Text
items.description:
• Instant, consistent; checks grammar and spelling.
• Catches common errors fast; objective; never tires.
• Misses subtle humor; can change meaning unintentionally.

items.title: Human: Recipe Finding
items.description:
• Endless scrolling through blogs, sifting for gems.
• Dietary needs ignored, missing key ingredients often.
• Adapts to what's on hand, real-time taste adjustments.

items.title: AI: Recipe Finding
items.description:
• Generates tailored recipes instantly based on input.
• Filters by diet, ingredients, skill level in seconds.
• No real taste judgment, can suggest unavailable items.

items.description:

• Networking, emotional intelligence in interviews.

items.title: AI: Job Searching
items.description:
• Scans thousands of listings, drafts tailored resumes.

items.description:
• Instant translation, practice sentences, vocabulary drill.

items.description:

items.description:
• Generates full itineraries in seconds based on criteria.

items.description:
• Drafts emails instantly, suggests subject lines and tone.

items.title: Human: Debugging Code
items.description:
• Can take hours, frustrating trial and error.
• Overlooking simple typos, getting stuck on one idea.
• Deeply understands project goals and user intent.

items.title: AI: Debugging Code
items.description:
• Instantly scans code, suggests common fixes quickly.

items.title: Human: Meal Planning
items.description:

items.description:
• Generates varied plans instantly, applies dietary rules.

items.description:

items.title: AI: Resume Writing
items.description:
• Generates drafts in seconds; quick keyword optimization.

items.title: Human: Translating Text
items.description:

items.description:
